name: Workbench MCP Server
description: Installs an MCP (Model Context Protocol) HTTP server that wraps the wb CLI, enabling AI assistants to interact with Workbench. Runs as a persistent daemon on port 9242, eliminating lazy-loading delays. Auto-configures Claude CLI and Gemini CLI.

userHomeDir.description: Home directory of the container user.

port.description: Port for the HTTP MCP server

toolsets.description: Comma-separated tool groups listed by default: core (always on), workflows, dataexplorer, apps, admin, docs, legacy, or all. With a loopback bindAddress, clients can add groups with ?toolsets= in the server URL; with any other bindAddress these groups are the most a client gets and ?toolsets= can only narrow them.

docsUrl.description: Site whose /docs/ pages the docs tools (group docs) search and read, from a copy built into the image and refreshed daily. Empty turns the docs tools off.

bindAddress.description: Address the HTTP MCP server listens on. 127.0.0.1 (default) keeps it to this container; 0.0.0.0 lets the container publish the port, for example to sandboxed agents on the same VM. WB_MCP_BIND overrides it at start. With any other address, the toolsets option is the most a client can enable.
